method: Production build; same saved output on independent disposable copies of the current application store; fresh backend process and Chromium browser each trial. OS disk cache not flushed. America/Toronto timezone; 1500x940 viewport.
output: Incremental persistence and durable recovery / Central diagram - baseline prompt / pass 1

measurements.loadMs: Navigation to the Evals output deep link until rendered ASCII is visible, followed by two animation frames.
measurements.deleteMs: Delete action (native confirmation auto-accepted before; in-app confirmation button after) until the selected output row disappears. Excludes human confirmation delay.
measurements.apiMs: Same deletion start until DELETE response body completes; includes browser dispatch time.
measurements.modalMs: Delete icon click until in-app confirmation is visible.

limitations: One representative output and local machine; fresh browser/server, not a cold operating-system cache. No active user records were deleted.
